_comment: What POST /register accepts as an agentUri before the facilitator pays to write it on-chain.
Compiled into the binary (src/erc8004/agent_uri.rs) and read by scripts/erc8004_custodied_identities.py,
so the guard and the audit of the identities the facilitator already holds apply the same lists.
Suffix match: a host matches an entry when it IS the entry or ends with '.' + entry.
wildcardDnsDomains resolve a name that embeds an IP to that IP. The embedded-IP rule in the code
already catches most of their names on any domain; the list catches the forms it cannot (hex, IPv6).
